design.reference_note: reference points are probe-OFF baseline dwells; drift is judged from the DUT stream RMS (dB, millions of samples, high SNR), never from a single lock-in amplitude

estimators.center_estimator: c_hat = argmax_c [mean_p(|f-c| <= ddc_passband_hz/2) - mean_p(|f-c| > ddc_passband_hz/2)] over c on a 50 kHz grid with the whole passband inside the swept range (a matched boxcar; NOT the guard-banded C1 sets, whose flat top makes the argmax arbitrary within +-0.22 MHz)
estimators.corrected_power: p = A_re^2 + A_im^2 - sigma2, sigma2 = mean lock-in power of 20 off-frequency bins (not mains, not harmonics of f_m)

invalid_if: dut power differs from the sweep median by more than power_tolerance_db
either bounding baseline dut_rms_db differs from the first baseline by more than reference_drift_db
exclusions.policy: alias-table exclusions are decided before any data, are reported, and do NOT count toward max_excluded_fraction; every other exclusion does. Excluded dwells are never replaced selectively. If more than max_excluded_fraction of the alias-eligible dwells at any fc are excluded, or an fc has fewer than min_valid_in valid in-band or min_valid_out valid out-of-band dwells, or fewer than 3 fc are complete, the verdict is INCONCLUSIVE_INCOMPLETE

gates.C3_controls: each Stage 2 control is PASS if the upper CI bound of its mean corrected power < control_max_fraction_of_signal * mean_p(IN) at the matching fc; FAIL if the lower CI bound >= that threshold; otherwise UNRESOLVED (the control is too noisy to show the response is small). UNRESOLVED never counts as a pass
gates.C4_sham: sham gate (applies only where a response was detected): PASS if the lower CI bound of power at f_m_sham > 0 AND the upper CI bound of power at f_m < control_max_fraction_of_signal * power at f_m_sham; FAIL if the lower CI bound of power at f_m >= that threshold; otherwise UNRESOLVED
gates.H0b_rule: H0b_NOT_SELECTIVE needs AFFIRMATIVE evidence: for every fc with a detected response, the one-sided bootstrap test that T = mean_p(IN) - 10^(selectivity_db/10)*mean_p(OUT) is below 0 has p <= detection_alpha_total / number_of_fc. If C1 or C2 fails without that evidence the verdict is INCONCLUSIVE (an underpowered selective channel must not be reported as non-selective)
gates.c3_c4_note: C3 strict form applies at an fc where the sweep detected a response; at an fc with no detection a control passes if it is itself not detected (lower CI bound <= 0). C4 applies only when a response was detected (otherwise vacuous)
gates.control_budget_note: resolving a 1% (-20 dB) response needs about (z_0.99 * mean sigma2 / (0.01 * mean_p(IN)))^2 control dwells at the sweep dwell length; longer control dwells divide that by the dwell-length ratio. Size the control runs from the Stage 1 noise floor before running them
gates.detection: for at least one fc, one-sided bootstrap of mean_p(IN) > 0 at alpha = detection_alpha_total / number_of_fc (Bonferroni)

sensitivity.note: s2 = mean corrected in-band power / mean sigma2 per 60 s dwell. Simulation (EXPERIMENT_E_PREREGISTRATION.md) gives about 95% detection of a 25 dB-selective channel at s2 = 8, about 27% at 4, near 0 at <= 2. The Stage 1 amplitude sweep (a calibration run whose data is NOT used in any confirmatory test) must find a probe level, below clipping (clip fraction < 1e-4), with s2 >= this value at the first fc; if none exists the experiment is not informative at this DUT/probe chain and stops. Every result reports its own s2 and detection limit; an H0a conclusion is only meaningful together with that limit.

sets.alias_note: rows whose alias_table.py verdict is CONTAMINATED or MARGINAL for the MEASURED filter are excluded before any test
sets.guard_note: dwells 0.8-1.6 MHz from fc are excluded from both sets (transition region and clock uncertainty)

stage4.blinding: secret fc drawn by a second operator from os.urandom; SHA-256 commitment published before the first trial; analyst estimates frozen and hashed before the reveal

tests.C1: intersection-union over all fc: one-sided percentile bootstrap (resampling dwells within IN and OUT) of T > 0; p_C1 = max over fc
tests.C2: (a) for every fc, permutation p of max_c S(c) with S the matched boxcar above under shuffling corrected power across valid probe frequencies, p_C2 = max over fc; AND (b) for every pair of fc, |(c_hat_B - c_hat_A) - (fc_B - fc_A)| <= center_shift_tolerance_hz
tests.C5: (a) permutation p (shuffle truth against estimates) of mean absolute error, one-sided; AND (b) MAE <= stage4_mae_floor_hz; AND (c) fraction within stage4_within_hz >= stage4_within_fraction
tests.holm_note: family size is fixed at 3 (C1, C2, C5) whether or not Stage 4 has run; a missing C5 enters as p = 1, so rung-4 claims are judged conservatively

title: Experiment E Stage 1-2 and 4: preregistered decision rules
verdict_order: CONTROLS_FAIL (a control FAILED: H0c or contamination; no inference about the DUT)
INCONCLUSIVE_CONTROLS (no control failed but at least one is UNRESOLVED: lengthen the controls)
H0a_NO_RESPONSE (no detection at any fc; report the detection limit)
H0b_NOT_SELECTIVE (detected, controls clean, C1 or C2 failed AND affirmative evidence that selectivity is below threshold at every detected fc)
H1_SUPPORTED_RUNG4 (C1 and C2 pass under Holm; physical emission depends on the digitally selected frequency)
H1_SUPPORTED_RUNG5 (as above and C5 passes: tuned frequency inferred under blinded conditions)
INCONCLUSIVE (anything else, including C1/C2 failing without affirmative non-selectivity)
